fourwheelers_atv_desc: A rugged four-wheeled runabout with a surtling-core engine, room for a passenger and a rack for your gear. Build it on dry land.
fourwheelers_help: W go, Shift+W full speed, S brake and reverse, A and D steer, Jump or E to get off.
fourwheelers_too_far: Get closer to the four wheeler to climb on.
fourwheelers_too_heavy: You are carrying too much to ride.
fourwheelers_server_missing: Four Wheelers isn't installed on this server, so four wheelers can't be built here.
